answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 46362 Country: India Title: ZAKAT Question: I have one doubt after giving zakah. Last year I came to know that the person whom I gave zakah was not eligible for receiving the zakah. Should I have to pay zakah again? Answer ID: 46362 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1024/1024/M=1434) If you give him zakah considering him eligible to receive zakah then your zakah was paid. It is not necessary to pay it again. دفع بتحر لمن ظنه مصرفاً ...... إن بان غناه أو كونه ذمقياً أو أنه أبوه أو ابنه أو امراته أو هاشمي لا يعيد (درمختار) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
